attacks.name: Ancient Throwing Blades
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

After this attack is resolved, if there is not an allied |£hand-ninjas-grunts£&*Hand Ninjas&| character in play, Place it in play within |!range| 1 of this character with an Activated token. It is part of your Squad.

attacks.name: Impale
steps: If an allied |*Hand Ninjas| character is within |!range| 2 of the defender, add 2 dice to the attack roll.
The defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes and cannot add additional dice to its defense roll as a result of |!critical| results.
After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Assassin‘s Step
superPowers.body: When this character deals |!damage| to an enemy character with an attack, after the attack is resolved, it may use this superpower. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the enemy character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Martial Prowess
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack within |!range| 2, it may use this superpower. Instead of rolling dice equal to its Defense, it rolls 5 defense dice. Then, if this character suffered no |!damage| from the attack, after the attack is resolved, the attacker suffers 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Out For Blood
superPowers.body: When this character deals |!damage| to an enemy character with an attack or superpower, after the attack or superpower is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and from 5 to 7 on Injured side.
"Ancient Throwing Blades" now gives 1 power, but cannot inflict Bleed anymore.
